==Description==
The '''Festive Tree''' is one of two rare consumables that are only obtainable through triumphing regular modes and and via a [[Holiday Crate]] with a 16.67% chance. However, the [[Holiday Crate]]s cannot be obtained anymore, they can only be opened.

Only up to three '''Festive Trees''' can be used in a match by a single player. It has a 60 second cooldown, however its initial cooldown is set to 0, allowing to be used on Wave 1. Its cooldown does not start until the '''Festive Tree''' disappears.

==Usage==
When using the '''Festive Tree''', a light brown pot with a dark green tree will appear, which can be placed on any part of the map. When placed down, it will lower the stun duration from enemies by 30%. It has a range of 16.

This does not stack with other '''Festive Trees'''.

==Appearance==
The '''Festive Tree''' is a dark green tree that has been planted into a pot. The tree is decorated with different colored ornaments.

==Strategy==
*The '''Festive Tree''' can be used as a replacement for the [[Medic]] tower as it has a very similar purpose.
**However, if a player has the [[Medic]] tower equipped, then this consumable serves no purpose.
***As such, players should save their Consumable slot for something else.
*This consumable does lower the stun that the [[Present Cluster Bomb]] can cause, making them a good combo.
